info.title: Rendobar API
info.description: Serverless media processing API. Watermark, transcode, caption, redact, and render videos with one API call. Credit-based billing. MCP-native for AI agents.

bearerAuth.bearerFormat: API key or OAuth access token
bearerAuth.description: Bearer authentication. Accepts an API key from https://app.rendobar.com/settings/api-keys (`Authorization: Bearer rb_xxx`) or an OAuth 2.1 access token. Both carry the same scopes and the same authority: what a caller may do is a property of the grant, not of how it authenticated.

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. Register a client at https://api.rendobar.com/oauth2/register or connect through an integration that does it for you. Scopes are granted at consent and carry the same authority as an API key holding them.

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key to prevent duplicate job creation

label.description: A short name for this job, such as "Trim intro for episode 12". Shown in the dashboard and returned with the job as `label`.

destinations.description: Where to deliver the output once the job completes, as storage://<id>[/<folder or path template>]. A bare id uses the connection's output path template. A folder (storage://prod-media/exports) keeps that template's file name inside the folder. A path containing a token ({job_id} {ext} {source_name} {date}) or ending in a file name is used as written. The whole output is delivered: a single file at that path, a multi-file output as a folder named after that path without its extension, and any structured data as a .json file with the same name (the whole path when the job returns only data).

url.description: HTTPS URL Rendobar POSTs the job result to on a terminal state

headers.description: Custom request headers (e.g. an Authorization bearer) sent with the callback POST. Lets it hit an authed target like Cloudflare's Workflows events endpoint directly. Framing and X-Rendobar-* headers are reserved.

verify.description: Opt into signing: when true, the callback POST carries an X-Rendobar-Signature (HMAC-SHA256, same scheme as webhooks). Verify it with your org callback signing secret (GET /orgs/current/callback-secret) via the SDK's verifyWebhook(). Default false leaves the callback unsigned.

events.description: Opt into EXTRA non-terminal events. The terminal events (complete/failed/cancelled) always fire and cannot be filtered out, so a waiter can never hang. Today the only opt-in extra is job.started (a progress ping fired when the job starts running).

callback.description: Per-job completion callback. On complete/failed/cancelled Rendobar POSTs the standard job envelope to this URL.

for.description: Delivery posture: "web" (small, modern, sRGB, stripped) or "archive" (lossless, preserve everything). Omit for raw defaults.

target.description: Target quality/size: "visually-lossless" | "balanced" | "efficient", a 1-100 quality number, or { quality } | { maxBytes } | { maxSize } | { bitrate }.

compatibility.description: Decode reach the output must guarantee: "modern" (~90%, best efficiency), "broad" (~99%, default), "legacy" (~100%, oldest decoders).

codec.description: Output codec, or 'auto' to pick the best one allowed by compatibility.

maxResolution.description: Cap the longest edge — a pixel value or a rung like "1080p". null = no cap.

colorspace.description: Preserve the source gamut, or convert to sRGB for web display.

alpha.description: Alpha: "preserve", "flatten" (onto white), or a "#RRGGBB" fill color.

metadata.description: Metadata: "all" (keep everything), "colorOnly" (strip EXIF/GPS; ICC preservation is best-effort), "none" (strip all).

effort.description: Encode effort — trades speed for compression.

forceReencode.description: Re-encode even if the input already meets the target.

dryRun.description: Return a predicted result (size, quality, cost) without encoding.

video.description: Video stream handling: whether soft subtitle tracks survive the encode, and which audio tracks are kept.

subtitles.description: Soft subtitle tracks: "strip" (default) or "preserve" (best-effort copy; fails if the output container cannot hold the codec).

audioTracks.description: Keep all audio tracks, only the primary, or drop audio entirely.

audio.description: Audio handling: an optional integrated-loudness target, and whether to keep or downmix the channel layout.

loudnessLufs.description: Normalize to this integrated LUFS target (e.g. -14). null = off.

channels.description: Keep the source channel layout, or downmix.

tuning.description: Expert overrides for the quality search: which metric verifies the result, and a hard quality floor it must never fall below.

metric.description: Override the verification oracle. 'auto' picks per medium.

floor.description: Hard minimum quality the output must never drop below.
